t: This is Abercorn Place, a street in St John's Wood that runs from the Edgware Road at Maida Vale east to Abbey Road, not far from Abbey Road Studios. It's named after the Duke of Abercorn, James Hamilton, an Anglo-Irish aristocrat and Conservative statesman who twice served as Lord Lieutenant of Ireland. He was a governor of Harrow School, which owned the estate this street was part of, and other nearby streets are named in a similar way. The housing here is a mixture, from the 1820s onwards. At the corner with Hamilton Terrace stands St Mark's Church, a Gothic building by Thomas Cundy, from 1847.
